children: Pilgrim’s Pride commenced a private offering of up to €500 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes to fund general corporate purposes including the Walkers Deli & Sausage acquisition.
Issuers launched a private offering of up to €500 million senior notes, subject to market conditions.
Net proceeds intended for general corporate purposes, including funding consideration for the Walkers Acquisition.
Offering is not conditioned on closing of the Walkers Acquisition and terms remain subject to finalization.
Notes will be offered only to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S.
Notes are unregistered under the Securities Act and cannot be sold in the U.S. absent registration or an exemption.
